items.title: Making a Blue Star Lantern
items.alt: A girl in mustard sleeves and denim dungarees folds a blue paper lantern with star cutouts at a craft table beside Hanukkah candles.
items.description: The blue lantern takes shape between the seated maker’s hands. Loose strips, scissors and a glue bottle cover the worktable, while a gold candleholder and a patterned cup of tools stand farther back.

items.title: Stitching a Felt Dreidel Ornament
items.alt: A man with glasses and an embroidered kippah sews a blue felt dreidel at a wooden craft desk beside a star ornament and thread.
items.description: Fine thread connects the needle to the blue felt ornament in the maker’s hand. His rust knitted vest contrasts with cream trousers, while a red pincushion and a separate star decoration rest on the desk.

items.title: Shaping a Clay Hanukkiah
items.alt: A woman in a navy apron smooths a clay candleholder with eight low holes and a raised helper holder on a wooden craft table.
items.description: The unpainted clay lamp lies flat on the worktop as the maker smooths its edge with her fingers. A raised central holder rises above the row of small holes, with a clay block and sculpting tools nearby.

items.title: Books and Gelt in a Hanukkah Gift Basket
items.alt: A woven basket lined with blue-and-silver cloth holds books, a blue gift box and a clear bag of gold chocolate coins.
items.description: A blue bow sits high on the basket’s arched handle above the wrapped treats and blank-covered books. Pale patterned cloth folds over the rim, giving the woven basket a soft blue-and-silver lining.

items.title: Three Stars in a Hanging Hoop
items.alt: Three colorful six-pointed stars hang inside a wooden hoop with translucent blue fabric, beads and a gold hanging loop.
items.description: Blue, turquoise and red star ornaments hang at different heights inside the round wooden frame. Beaded strings and a gold loop connect the mobile above its translucent pale-blue fabric backing.

items.title: Dreidel and Gelt Beside a Velvet Pouch
items.alt: A blue embroidered drawstring pouch lies open beside a wooden dreidel and scattered gold and silver chocolate coins.
items.description: Golden cords trail from the open velvet pouch, whose surface carries leafy embroidery. A decorated wooden dreidel leans at its mouth above a small scatter of foil-wrapped coins.
